mostWorthwhile.text: Restoring the radio was the most worthwhile passage: the twelve-minute-old message made the communication delay tangible and opened a thread I wanted to follow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the window quilt involved several predictable steps, and the intermediate results offered little explanation until it was installed.

surprise.text: The radio message made the delay feel real, and the final battery result introduced a fuel-cell backup I had not anticipated.

arbitrary.text: None felt especially arbitrary, although charging the battery was the only available combination at the end and its connection to the fuel-cell backup was not clear beforehand.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to hear the eventual reply and see how the expedition develops, especially if future discoveries explain more about how the systems work.
